summary_en: 33,500 shares to be acquired without compensation on 2026-08-03 and cancelled on 2026-08-13 following termination of executive equity-grant trust (implemented FY3/24). Specific post-cancellation share count to be announced after board resolution.
title_en: Notice on Termination of Executive Share Grant Trust and Share Cancellation Policy
translation_en_brief: Chikaranomoto Holdings has resolved to terminate its executive share grant trust (established FY3/24) and to acquire and cancel the residual shares held in that trust. Under the trust agreement provisions and Companies Act Article 155 Section 13, the company will acquire 33,500 shares without compensation on 2026-08-03. A board resolution to cancel those shares is scheduled for 2026-08-13. The company will announce the specific number of shares to be cancelled and the post-cancellation share count following that board meeting. The trust was structured as a non-monetary trust with Resona Bank as trustee, benefiting eligible executives, and was intended to continue for the life of the compensation program. The termination reflects a broader policy review of performance-linked executive compensation.
